provenance.provenance_evidence: The project-owned projection passage reproduces the retained calendar body hash exactly. Its artifact manifest records the bounded public-domain 1862 Pustet antecedent, the separate 1962 target, and every editorial transformation; neither witness is represented as owning the projected bytes. The 1962 reading was established on that edition's page images rather than its text layer, cross-read against the Benziger conformed printing. Differences from the antecedent: conclusion length differs: the 1962 prints "Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre in unitate."; the antecedent prints "Qui vivis. Et, in Quadragesima, fit Commemor"; accents, ae/oe ligatures and word division differ throughout; the antecedent reading is an optical text layer and its pointing cannot be trusted at comma level. Corroboration: 1862 at text-layer lines 102491-102510 (printed p. 2), alignment 0.84.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Domine Jesu Christe, qui, ad recolendam memoriam dolorum sanctissimae
Genetricis tuae, per septem beatos Patres nova Servorum ejus familia
Ecclesiam tuam fecundasti: concede propitius; ita nos eorum consociari
fletibus, ut perfruamur et gaudiis: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre in
unitate.

provenance.provenance_authority: Triptych editorial projection verified by page-image collation against the 1962 target edition
provenance.provenance_evidence: The project-owned projection passage reproduces the retained calendar body hash exactly. Its artifact manifest records the bounded public-domain 1862 Pustet antecedent, the separate 1962 target, and every editorial transformation; neither witness is represented as owning the projected bytes. The 1962 reading was established on that edition's page images rather than its text layer, cross-read against the Benziger conformed printing. Differences from the antecedent: the antecedent window does not carry a conclusion at this point; the 1962 prints "Per eundem Dominum."; accents, ae/oe ligatures and word division differ throughout; the antecedent reading is an optical text layer and its pointing cannot be trusted at comma level. Corroboration: none reached the 0.55 alignment floor. Recorded limitation: The 1962 reading was settled on the facsimile page image; the antecedent reading is an optical text layer only and its letterforms and pointing were not verified on a page image (the 1862's images are not available to this lane, and the Mame's were not rendered for this entry). What was NOT checked: the Benziger conformed printing was used only as a boundary check on the extraction, never as a reading; no attempt was made to establish which of several possible loci in the antecedent is the 'original' one, since an order is not a contribution. This oration is one the Missal draws from a Common; the antecedent witness may print it at the Common, at another saint's day, or at both. That is a difference of position, not of words.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Accipe, quaesumus, Domine, hostias quas tibi offerimus: et praesta; ut,
intercedentibus Sanctis tuis, libera tibi mente serviamus, et perdolentis
Virginis Genetricis Filii tui amore inflammemur. Per eundem Dominum.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Caelestibus refecti mysteriis te, Domine, deprecamur: ut, quorum festa
percolimus imitantes exempla; juxta Crucem Jesu cum Maria Matre ejus
fideliter adstemus, et ejusdem redemptionis fructum percipere mereamur. Per
eundem Dominum.
